theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline theme and among the highest-scoring eligible names, with durability_bar 0.84, hurst_tag 'trend', and breadth 1.0. The validated absolute-trend gate is on (eligible=true), which is the only leg with a real drawdown-control edge. Crowding (z 1.46) is a size-down caution, not a fade signal.
